name: Varmint's Eittris
summary:
Varmint's EITtris Version 1.22 is a freeware competative Tetris game.
Up to four people/computer opponents can EIT each other simultaneously. (Or, for the more timid types, one person can play standard Tetris solitaire.) Lots of special weapons and game play enhancements make this game stand out from your average Tetris clone. Play for score, rows cleared, or who is best at hosing their opponents. Uses SVGA graphics and Sound Blaster Sound. WARNING: EITtris has been found to cause
cancer in laboratory rats.
